<action>
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/conversations.list \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "exclude_archived=false&limit=1000&types=public_channel,private_channel" | jq -r '.channels[] | select(.name | contains("onboarding")) | .id,.name'
</action>

<thinking>
Now that I have the channel ID for the onboarding channel, I need to check how many members it has to verify it has exactly 6 members before posting the message.
</thinking>

<action>
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/conversations.members \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "channel=C07HMFNR5PH&limit=100" | jq '.members | length'
</action>

<thinking>
Perfect! The onboarding channel has exactly 6 members. Now I can post the message to this channel.
</thinking>

<action>
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "channel=C07HMFNR5PH&text=Please complete the compliance training module by Friday." | jq '.'
</action>
